clickBehavior.description: Opens full-width tools panel with 4 icon cards (A Hyundai, Universo Hyundai, Hyundai Financiamentos, Fale com a Hyundai) + 8 text links. Header turns solid white (rgb(255,255,255)). Hamburger morphs to cross via CSS transform (is-active class). Nav text color changes to dark navy (rgb(0,44,95)).

hoverBehavior.description: Opens dropdown panel with 2 icon cards (Bluelink, Assistência 24H) + 7 text links (Programa Meu Hyundai, Acessórios HB20, Garantia, Acessórios CRETA, Manuais, Agendamento de Serviço, Proconve). Header turns solid white. Teal underline under trigger.
Opens dropdown panel with 2 icon cards (Planos de Manutenção, myHyundaiCare Revisões Planejadas) + 1 text link (Recall). Header turns solid white. Teal underline under trigger.

Opens megamenu panel with featured vehicle area (image + specs) + 5 category tabs (Todos, Suv, Hatchback, Sedan, Utilitario) + 9 vehicle cards in grid. Featured area updates on vehicle card hover. Header turns solid white. Teal underline under trigger.
Opens dropdown panel with 2 icon cards (Agendamento de Serviço, Test Drive) + dealer search form (3 radio options, text input, submit button). Header turns solid white. Teal underline under trigger.
no dropdown, no visible hover effect

Opens dropdown panel with 2 icon cards (Ofertas, Estoque - Pronta Entrega) + 7 text links (Click to Buy, Hyundai Semprenovos, Monte o seu, Vendas Diretas e PcD, Test Drive, Financiamentos, Compare seu Hyundai). Header turns solid white. Teal underline under trigger.
Background color darkens from #00aad2 to #0090b3 on hover
